content.text:
This confirms it: commit `7cc0252` changed the `IPlayerClientListener` interface signature (and its internal caller `PlayerClient`) to pass a `Position` to `onUpdateCheckpointDirection`, but missed updating the other implementer, `StartUpView.java`'s anonymous inner class, which still had `@Override public void onUpdateCheckpointDirection()` with no parameter — a compile-breaking mismatch that `adae741` later fixes.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 7cc0252986b7d49832af143711f5abacd4adb01f

## Reasoning
(1) The fix commit `adae741` adds a `Position` parameter to `StartUpView`'s `@Override`-annotated `onUpdateCheckpointDirection()` method. Since this is an `@Override` on an anonymous class implementing `IPlayerClientListener`, the signature must exactly match the interface method — so I traced the git history of `IPlayerClientListener.java` to find when its `onUpdateCheckpointDirection` signature changed.

(2) I found three history points: `a28ede2` (interface created, no-arg method), `31bbadb` (added an `Adapter` static class, still no-arg), and `7cc0252` (changed the interface method to `onUpdateCheckpointDirection(Position position)`, and correspondingly updated `PlayerClient.java`'s own implementation/caller to pass the `Position`). `7cc0252` is confirmed to be an ancestor of `adae741`.

(3) `7cc0252` changed the interface contract but only updated the implementer inside `PlayerClient.java` — it did not touch `StartUpView.java`, which contains another anonymous implementation of the same interface still using the old no-arg signature with `@Override`. This left `StartUpView.java` broken/incompatible with the interface until `adae741` fixed it by adding the missing `Position` parameter. This is a straightforward incomplete-refactor bug: the interface method signature was changed in one file but not propagated to all implementers.

I'm confident in this identification since the evidence directly ties the specific method-signature change to the fix's counterpart change, and the commit ordering/ancestry is verified.
